description: Compare-and-set on cells of one item, all or none. Each cell carries the value you read (`expected`, null = empty) and the value to write. If any cell no longer holds its `expected`, nothing is written and the answer is an error with code CELL_CONFLICT and `conflicts` [{columnId, current}]: read again (use `current`), decide again, and never resend the same call. CELL_BUSY (the row is being written) also writes nothing: read again, then retry. Plain columns only (not relation, file, lookup, rollup, formula, button or system columns). Use set_cell for a write that needs no precondition.

cells.description: 1 to 50 cells of this item, each column once

expected.description: The value you read, exactly as it came back (null = empty or missing)

value.description: The value to write; null clears the cell

name: set_cells_if_unchanged
